studio.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced. At 5.125 seconds, <Picture 2> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] One continuous photorealistic live-action shot of the adult cyclist in the supplied opening and ending images, wearing a red jacket, dark trousers, sunglasses and a black helmet, riding the same blue road bicycle along the sunny coastal promenade. Begin with the side-on medium-wide composition of <Picture 1>. The cyclist repeatedly pedals, both wheels rotate, the body sways naturally and the open red jacket flutters in the sea breeze. A smoothly travelling camera follows the rider and gradually advances closer, finishing at the slightly front-side, tighter composition shown in <Picture 2>. Railings, lamp posts and promenade paving pass with strong foreground parallax while the sea stays distant. Preserve the rider's identity, realistic human anatomy and the bicycle's construction throughout. Maintain forward travel from the opening through the ending, without cuts or a freeze at either keyframe.

overall_soundscape: Continuous bicycle tyre hum on paving, rhythmic chain and pedal sounds, light sea breeze and distant waves, matching the moving cyclist. No speech.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

model_type.label: Pipeline Type
model_type.description: Selects the Modular Diffusers pipeline class. This filters compatible checkpoints and publishes the component contract used by connected nodes; it is not the model checkpoint itself.

reviewed_variant.label: Model
reviewed_variant.description: Select an immutable, reviewed checkpoint for this exact Modular Diffusers pipeline family. Changing it does not replace the workflow graph or reset its parameters.

attention_backend.label: Attention Backend
attention_backend.description: Inherit preserves existing native component defaults; explicit choices use the ordinary Diffusers attention API.

vae_slicing.label: VAE Slicing
vae_slicing.description: An unset policy preserves the native VAE configuration; templates may bind an explicit boolean.

vae_tiling.label: VAE Tiling
vae_tiling.description: An unset policy preserves the native VAE configuration; templates may bind an explicit boolean.

inpaint_compatibility.label: Inpaint Compatibility
inpaint_compatibility.description: Technical compatibility selection for the reviewed Qwen Edit inpainting candidate; existing nodes retain native policy.

trust_remote_code.label: Trust Remote Code
trust_remote_code.description: Repository code execution is disabled; keep this off for contract preview.

revision.label: Revision
revision.description: Required exact 40-character commit hash for Hub custom contracts.

workflow_id.label: Reviewed Workflow
workflow_id.description: Exact reviewed component partition selected by a first-party Cluster Node.

weight_loading_mode.label: Weight Loading
weight_loading_mode.description: Load weights on CPU or CUDA before disk offload. CUDA loading needs room for a complete component and is available only for supported models.

weight_format.label: Weight Format
weight_format.description: Select a backend-declared immutable component format. Missing reviewed files must be installed through Model Manager.
